summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares an obfuscated `preinstall` (`node setup.mjs`) that at `npm install` time downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the platform-specific binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a shipped 700KB `math_init.js` file. `math_init.js` is a `@bun @bun-cjs` bundled artifact using string-array rotation obfuscation (obfuscator.io shape); its behavior is intentionally hidden from static inspection. The package is advertised as a shared React repository configuration and has no functional need for a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque bundled payload. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute a sibling obfuscated blob on install bypasses Node-based inspection and delivers attacker-authored code with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
